item.title: Verbose beta 328
item.description:
Faster dictation paste and a headset check

Mac

  • Dictation cleans finished sentences while you talk, so the paste comes sooner. Only the last sentence is cleaned after you let go. It runs on this Mac with Apple Intelligence, never with cloud cleanup, and Esc discards it.
  • The log's timing line counts the sentences cleaned ahead, to measure the gain.
  • Verbose tells you when a Bluetooth headset records in call mode. Call mode is phone-call audio, so words can be less accurate. You see it once a day at most. The built-in mic or a wired mic records better.
  • Verbose keeps private numbers on how Only keep my voice would decide. With a voice profile, each dictation is scored after it pastes. Only numbers are kept, on this Mac, never words or audio. Deleting your voice profile deletes them.
  • Delete All Data on the Mac now deletes your voice profile and saved voices. Before, the voice profile and the voices of speakers you named stayed on the Mac. The iPhone already deleted them.

Also on iPhone

  • The iPhone's Only keep my voice switch now filters keyboard dictation.
